description: The ENTSO-E dynamic model of Continental Europe is a simplified, anonymised dynamic model of the synchronous transmission grid of continental Europe, released to third parties for research. It is published by ENTSO-E, the association of European transmission system operators, through its Continental Europe system operation pages. Coverage: a detailed description of the 400 kV and 230 kV transmission systems of all continental European countries, without sub-transmission and distribution networks, so it reproduces the general dynamic behaviour of the system: the main frequency response and the main inter-area oscillation modes. Format and access: model files in the proprietary DIgSILENT PowerFactory and PSS/E formats, with a public report and an instruction manual (version 2) on model construction and validation; access requires a request form with non-disclosure provisions, signed by a legal entity (a separate form exists for universities) and sent to ENTSO-E, and the model is not delivered to private persons; no fee is mentioned. Licence: use under the signed non-disclosure request form, for clearly described research or specific activities. Caveats: ENTSO-E states the model is suitable only for frequency stability and small-signal stability, or as a boundary network around a detailed regional model, and not for voltage or transient stability, harmonics, protection, special protection schemes or congestion; it recommends use under the supervision of its dynamic experts. Simulation uses: frequency stability and inter-area oscillation studies of the European grid, including cascading disturbances and resilience to generation loss. Related records: PyPSA-Eur (model-pypsa-eur) offers an open static model of the European grid for comparison.
